story:
Jesus fills the fishermen's empty nets with fish and calls Peter, Andrew, James and John to follow Him (Luke 5:1-11, Matthew 4:18-22). Grandpa Sol tells the story to Zara, Eli and Pip, with a sing-along song at the end.

Memory verse: "Follow Me" (Matthew 4:19)
Memory line: Jesus says, Follow Me!

Talk about it together:
Ages 2-3: What filled the nets? (Fish!)
Ages 4-8: Why did Simon listen to Jesus even though he was tired? What did the fishermen do next? How can we follow Jesus this week?
Prayer: Dear God, thank You for calling us to follow Jesus. Help us listen and say yes. Amen.
Activity (5 minutes): Cut paper fish, write a way to follow Jesus on each one (be kind, share, pray), and put them in a box "net".

🎵 Sing along with the lyrics:

[Verse 1]
Fishermen by the water blue
Fishing all night, nothing to do
Empty nets, the morning came
Then Jesus called each one by name

[Chorus]
Follow Me, follow Me
Come and walk along with Me
Jesus calls, and we say yes
Follow Me, He loves us best!

[Verse 2]
Put the nets out, deep and wide
Fish came flapping, side to side
Boats so full they almost sank
Jesus gave, and they gave thanks

[Chorus]
Follow Me, follow Me
Come and walk along with Me
Jesus calls, and we say yes
Follow Me, He loves us best!

[Verse 3]
Peter, Andrew, James and John
Left their nets and followed on
Jesus is the kindest friend
We will follow to the end

[Chorus - lifted]
Follow Me, follow Me
Come and walk along with Me
Jesus calls, and we say yes
Follow Me, He loves us best!

[Outro]
Follow Me!
Yes, Jesus, yes!

#EliorasBibleStories #BibleForKids #KidsSongs #Jesus
